notes.title: Achievements (beta)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. I have just implemented some 'so-requested' achievements that should be available for Windows and Linux version for now. Let me know if you managed to unlock at least one.

The simplest one is to gather 2000 points on match-three mode.
